summary.text: This resolution expresses support for the designation of National Dyspraxia/Developmental Coordination Disorder (DCD) Awareness Week.

title: Expressing support for the designation of October 9 through October 16, 2025, as "National Dyspraxia/Developmental Coordination Disorder (DCD) Awareness Week" and a commitment to raise awareness of dyspraxia/DCD in the United States.
